title: A security review score
description:
Score a driver design against the secure-design checklist.

```
device secured with an SDDL string:   yes
IOCTLs check input sizes:             yes
FILE_ANY_ACCESS on a write IOCTL:     no (good)
user pointers probed and captured:    no  -> FIX
symbolic link needed at all:          yes
score 4/5, fix: probe and capture user pointers
```
hints: Loop with an index so the question and answer stay paired (lesson 5.03).
Keep the checklist data separate from the code that scores it, so new questions are one line.
requirements: A list of yes/no questions from lesson 5.03, each with the answer that is safe.
Print every question, mark the unsafe answers, and give the score.
A design with any "critical" item unsafe fails whatever the score.
stretch: Read the answers from a text file kept with the driver's source.
